rules.statement: The inherent powers of the court cannot be invoked to violate express provisions, and addition of parties can only occur before judgment is delivered in a partition case.
rules.supporting_quote: Inherent power of the court cannot be invoked to violate the express provisions. APPLICATION for leave to appeal from an order of the District Court of Gampaha with leave being granted.
